scope: CPU import, real onBeforeCompile hooks against installed Three physical shaders, mask lexical scope, bound uniforms, non-canyon shader unchanged outside the isolated leaf-load feature block, and all coordinate/relief code unchanged versus committed v17; separate dragged-leaf versus grass/plain cache variants, coating reuse/restoration/disposal, numeric finite cases. No GLSL compiler, GPU link, actual frame or worlds.js geometry audit.
behaviorNotes: Non-rich canyon still receives the 30% authored body transfer and the new clearcoat mask, although direct atlas colour remains zero.
At atlas ready=0 the 30% body transfer and clearcoat mask still apply; these additions are not gated by atlas readiness.
Canyon currently has no loadRange. Adding one later would require moving the mask declaration outside that branch before its coat use.
The new body load has no crown-style 0.94 peak clamp; positive HDR authored inputs can yield values above one without nonfinite output.

Only flagged geometry named dragged-pigment-leaf-* enables the new colour multiplier. Narrow grass geometry/botanical/plain active code excludes it. Coastal batches named grass that use dragged-leaf geometry are included. All other non-canyon shader code is unchanged; cache keys include both blade and leafLoad flags.
The leaf multiplier also applies at ready=0, using the existing fallback atlas; it adds no samples or uniforms and retains the same relief/UV/normal/coat code.
The mask changes albedo coverage and clearcoat, not main roughnessFactor, texture coordinates, normal relief or physical displacement.
